reserves.name: ETH and ETH-derivative collateral

reserves.name: Other protocol assets
reserves.issuerOrObligor: River protocol stablecoin and small-token positions not identified as satUSD collateral

reserveReview.rationale: River FAQ and product pages state satUSD is over-collateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, and LSTs, but the issuer publishes no category-weighted breakdown. The 2026-08-08 DefiLlama River protocol token inventory (~$81.3M) is overwhelmingly BTC and BTC-derivatives (~99.5% of identified token value), with ETH/WEETH/WETH at ~0.35%, WBNB below display precision, and stablecoins/small tokens at ~0.17%. Because the DefiLlama inventory is aggregate protocol TVL rather than satUSD-specific vault collateral, the split is treated as an approximation: 99.5% BTC-derivative collateral, 0.4% ETH-derivative collateral, and 0.1% residual other protocol assets.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer collateral disclosures plus approximate category grouping of the latest DefiLlama River protocol token inventory (not a satUSD-specific vault attestation)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: River does not publish current weights among BTC, ETH, BNB, and LSTs for satUSD specifically; the DefiLlama breakdown is aggregate protocol TVL and may include non-satUSD positions.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: BTC and wrapped/bridged BTC variants are native reserve backing rather than tracked stablecoin dependencies.
ETH and wrapped/staked ETH variants are native reserve backing rather than tracked stablecoin dependencies.
Residual stablecoin and small-token positions are not tracked stablecoin dependencies.
